messages.subject: Command line install and uninstall
parts:
What are the command line options to install r open in a headless fashion?

Examples I've seen for other installation programs:
C:\>Install.exe /S
C:\>Install.exe /S REMOVE TRUE

messages.author: 2aed7cbfca222ffd
messages.subject: Re: Command line install and uninstall
parts:
Hello Vincent,

Their aren't any special installation considerations for installing on a headless server without X11.
You just go ahead and complete a regular command-line based install of Revolution R Open - see: http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/
If you do install it on a headless server, your R users won't have interactive graphics capabilities and will
need to output their graphics to graphic files.

Is this machine connected to the internet?  If not, another consideration will be how your R users will install packages.
In that case, you will want to setup your own internal R package mirror.
